answer_1.quote: We evaluate the performance of HD-EVAL on three NLG evaluation scenario: Summarization (SummEval), Conversation (Topical-Chat) and Data-to-Text (SFRES and SFHOT).
answer_1.outputs: Summaries, dialogue responses, and data-to-text generations

answer_2.quote: Baselines We compare our HD-EVAL against a series of automatic evaluation baselines, including ROUGE, BERTScore, PRISM, BartScore, and UniEval. For LLM-based evaluation, we select GPT-4 Evaluation

answer_3.quote: Hierarchy-Aware Prompting to preserve the hierarchical relations when evaluating a decomposed criteria (node).

answer_4.quote: Human score label (s k ∈ R p ) is a numeric vector containing evaluation scores for a total of p evaluation aspects for a training sample
answer_4.guideline: evaluation scores for a total of p evaluation aspects
